headline: Roberto De Zerbi on latest Tottenham training ploy: 'We removed phones' from meals
description: Roberto De Zerbi has revealed phones were banned from meals during Tottenham's warm weather training camp in Marbella in his latest attempt to turn a vastly-assembled squad into a team.

headline: Dominic Calvert-Lewin 'showed respect by standing' as others took knee for racism campaign - Daniel Farke
description: Leeds boss Daniel Farke has said that striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin showed "respect" after not taking the knee prior to Leeds United's draw with Manchester United on Sunday.

headline: Mikel Arteta puts stale Arsenal display down to Nottingham Forest tactics: 'They put a Christmas tree there'
description: Mikel Arteta has defended his Arsenal team after they only managed one shot on target in their 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest on Sunday.

headline: Arsenal don't look ready to 'attack' the Premier League title like they want to -- yet
description: Defending Premier League champions Arsenal put in a weak attacking performance at Nottingham Forest -- but maybe that's just fine.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Viktor Gyökeres leave Arsenal in January?
description: Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres could leave the club in January, while Manchester United are looking to bolster their squad in January. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Nicol: Arsenal fans will be frustrated that games are more difficult than they should be
description: Nicol: Arsenal fans will be frustrated that games are more difficult than they should be
